data.rationale: The proposal gets the GitHub search, profile, top repo and lead email right, but it drops the whole blog step (opening {blog} in a new tab to read the latest post title) and never says to note the follower count; it also lists values read during the task (followers, top_repo, stars_language, latest_post) as inputs instead of the real parameters (blog is missing, and recipient_email should be fixed), and "Discard (or Send)" contradicts the rule never to send, so an automation built from it would lack its data sources and could send the email.
